messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High p99 token latency for streaming responses in eu-central-1. Error rate up ~6%. Paging oncall.

alice: I'm awake, looking.
ben: seeing sustained headroom drop on serving pool -> queues backing up. Client connections spiking.
carol: Any customer-facing errors? Support seeing a few SLO alerts from big clients.
alice: quick diag: tails of token latency, no infra OOMs. Looks like runtime backpressure at mux layer. Plan: temporarily disable realtime streaming responses for hosted API in eu-central-1 and route affected requests to chunked-polling fallback + enable strict per-tenant token rate caps. Rolling by AZ.
ben: +1. Recommend 5-10 minute window, staged AZs. Apply traffic-shaper rule `streaming:off -> responses:polling` in the edge router and set token caps.
dave: prepping ratecap: `rlimit --tenant=all --tokens-per-sec=5` and a stricter per-tenant burst. Will exempt Dedicated customers if needed.
alice: executing toggle now: `infra toggle-feature --region eu-central-1 --feature streaming_responses --state disable --reason "latency spike"`
deploy-bot: Command received. Executing toggle: streaming_responses in eu-central-1 -> DISABLED (rolled to 2/3 AZs). Audit: https://console.redwood.internal/toggles/3290012345
runtime-bot: Router update applied. Chunked-polling fallback enabled. KV prefix cache still active, prefix hits stable.
ben: monitoring: p99 tokens dropped ~60% within 30s. Throughput stable, connection errors decreasing.
carol: drafting customer advisory. Proposed blurb: "We temporarily shifted streaming responses to polling in eu-central-1 to stabilize latency. No data loss expected; reconnect recommended." Share edits?
erin: Please add ETA for restoration: aiming to re-enable streaming with a canary in 10-15m if p99 stays below threshold. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
alice: Handoff: switching watch to dave for the next window (00:00-04:00 UTC). If latency resurfaces, escalate to IC.
dave: taking it. I'll watch metrics and run a gradual canary to re-enable: enable 1% of traffic -> 10% -> 50% over 5m windows if stable.
frank: billing ops note: polling can increase token churn. Setting soft quota warnings: `quota_notify --region eu-central-1 --threshold 80%`. Will prepare temporary quota increases for blocked customers.
carol: Sent advisory to affected customers and posted status update. Copy: "We temporarily switched streaming to polling to stabilize latency in eu-central-1. You may see slightly higher token usage; contact support for quota adjustments"
alice: Mitigation applied at 3290012365. Monitoring continuous. Close when streaming re-enabled and p99 stable for 10m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place; escalation level: P2; paging silenced; oncall owner: dave.
